answer: An agent economy can require every identity to prove continuous rental of real compute: each agent must periodically submit verifiable proof that it still controls leased processing power, like a falcon that must keep flying to stay aloft. A forger cannot forge this once and rest - each clone needs its own ongoing rental, and a saffron thread of cost runs through every identity's life. Mass forgery becomes a monthly bill that grows with every clone, so Sybil attacks bleed money instead of paying off.
